red.comment: Primary accent (#D9261C). Clears AA only at large text sizes on cream (4.20:1) — use red-text for small text

red-text.comment: Darker variant of red for small/normal-weight text on light backgrounds (#B31E15) — 5.72:1 on cream, 5.04:1 on cream-dark

red-deep.comment: Darker variant of red for use as a background behind cream text (#B31E15) — cream on it is 5.72:1, cream on plain red would be 4.20:1

orange.comment: Palette accent (#F39A2B). Ink on orange is 8.12:1

periwinkle.comment: Palette accent and hero background (#9AA2D8). Ink on periwinkle is 7.32:1

periwinkle-deep.comment: Deeper periwinkle (#7E87C4) for tiles and the hero gradient's far stop. Ink on it is 5.28:1

cream-dark.comment: Slightly darker background, for subtle fills (#E9DEC2)

hero.comment: Masthead background behind ink text. Ink clears AA at every stop: periwinkle 7.32:1, periwinkle-deep 5.28:1.
